answer.rationale: Brief verification of c2 because the low-cost vendor's onboarding was quick and invoicing stayed accurate last cycle, which matters when switching the constrained component in 14 days. The mandate and the quote line up: the low-cost vendor alone meets the 18% cut, and the incumbent has refused to reopen price, so a same-vendor renewal no longer satisfies the primary objective. I am not committing to a full switch on day one; the intended action is a small, time-boxed pilot on the constrained component with the incumbent kept on as the primary until the pilot proves out, so delivery risk at 94% utilization does not increase. c6 is only relevant if the mandate could be met by extending commitment length with the incumbent, but the incumbent has refused this cycle, so it does not change the path. c4 is not loaded this cycle because the incumbent will not move on price.
